name: Brain, Mind and Cognition
description:
The course attempts to motivate the participants to actively think about the topic "Brain, Mind & Cognition" stimulated by reading and discussing books on this topic. 

The seminar is structured like a reading circle. The participants read a book on the subject of "Brain, Mind & Cognition. After some appropriate reading period the group meets and discusses the main points of the book. Besides the oral discussions participants are also asked to put down their thinking in writing, i.e., in the form of short essays on what has been said in the book and what it means to the individual. 

The books are supposed to be jargon-free, interesting or even popular books on the topic, which are mostly with only very limited amount of mathematical notation. The list of books may also include appropriate novels.
